===Etymology===
This telegraph symbol {{lang|zh|〷}} became part of Unicode due to its inclusion in Row 15 of GB 8565.2-88 {{lang|zh|表}} A4 (1988), from 9999 of {{lang|zh|标准电码本（修订本）}} (1983). First appears in 1952. See also [[Appendix:Chinese telegraph code/Mainland 1983]] and {{w|Chinese telegraph code}}.

===Symbol===

# {{lb|zh|telegraphy}} a [[line feed]]
